topic.title: Learned Representations for Long-Horizon Planning
topic.overview: Planning over many steps becomes easier when observations are compressed into states that preserve reachability and useful subgoals. This cluster joins goal-conditioned policies, exploration, replay-buffer search, and latent world models. The common challenge is reducing the search over action sequences without discarding the structure needed to reach a new goal.
topic.whyItMatters: A compact visual embedding may be excellent for recognition yet misleading for planning if nearby points cannot reach one another. Representations and exploration strategies must therefore reflect controllable transitions, not just perceptual similarity.
topic.evolution: The collection spans abstraction and tactical planning from 1989 to modern learned planners. Representatives from 2019–2024 combine policy learning, curiosity, graphs, and reachability-aware latent states. Recent examples extend planning design to language agents and analyze diffusion guidance through stochastic control, including probabilistic constraint-satisfaction guarantees.
openQuestions: How can a learned abstraction preserve reachability under changing dynamics?
Can planning guarantees remain useful when the world model is imperfect?

papers.title: Graph-Assisted Stitching for Offline Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: GAS uses graph search to stitch transitions across recorded trajectories and choose subgoals for offline hierarchical reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Hierarchical Planning for Complex Tasks with Knowledge Graph-RAG and Symbolic Verification
papers.tldr: Combining knowledge-graph retrieval, hierarchical planning, and symbolic validation improves LLM planning across tasks and models.

papers.title: HyperTree Planning: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Hierarchical Thinking
papers.tldr: HyperTree Planning iteratively develops hierarchical outlines, achieving a reported 3.6-fold improvement over o1-preview on TravelPlanner with Gemini-1.5-Pro.

papers.title: Rejecting Hallucinated State Targets during Planning
papers.tldr: A learned feasibility evaluator filters impossible planning targets and reduces delusional behavior across several tested agents.

papers.title: SAH-Drive: A Scenario-Aware Hybrid Planner for Closed-Loop Vehicle Trajectory Generation
papers.tldr: SAH-Drive coordinates rule-based and learned planners to improve driving generalization without substantial additional runtime in the reported evaluation.

papers.title: Scaling Value Iteration Networks to 5000 Layers for Extreme Long-Term Planning
papers.tldr: DT-VIN combines dynamic transitions and improved gradient flow to scale differentiable planning to 5,000 layers.

papers.title: Simultaneous Multi-Robot Motion Planning with Projected Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: SMD integrates constrained optimization into diffusion sampling to generate feasible multi-robot trajectories with improved reported success and efficiency.

papers.title: Strategic Planning: A Top-Down Approach to Option Generation
papers.tldr: Strategist turns language-model-generated strategies into sub-goals and shaped rewards, yielding faster convergence than conventional PPO in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Task-Agnostic Pre-training and Task-Guided Fine-tuning for Versatile Diffusion Planner
papers.tldr: SODP pretrains a diffusion planner on broad suboptimal trajectories, then uses limited reward-guided fine-tuning to adapt it to specific tasks.

papers.title: TeLoGraF: Temporal Logic Planning via Graph-encoded Flow Matching
papers.tldr: TeLoGraF combines graph encoding and flow matching to solve diverse temporal-logic tasks, improving tested satisfaction rates and speeding inference relative to classical planners.

papers.title: Classical Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics: Challenging the State of the Art with Python Code
papers.tldr: LLM-generated Python heuristics guide classical planners toward correct solutions and solve more unseen tasks than direct LLM planning in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: Compositional Monte Carlo Tree Diffusion for Extendable Planning
papers.tldr: C-MCTD extends diffusion-based planning by searching over complete plan compositions, using parallel exploration and cached plan graphs to manage computation.

papers.title: Contrastive Representations for Temporal Reasoning
papers.tldr: CRTR changes contrastive sampling to learn temporal structure, solving arbitrary Rubik's Cube states with fewer search steps but longer solutions than BestFS.

papers.title: Curriculum Design for Trajectory-Constrained Agent: Compressing Chain-of-Thought Tokens in LLMs
papers.tldr: Gradually tightening training constraints helps agents meet deployment requirements and enables shorter LLM reasoning outputs with reported inference speedups.

papers.title: Generative Trajectory Stitching through Diffusion Composition
papers.tldr: CompDiffuser generates plans for new tasks by jointly stitching overlapping trajectory chunks with a bidirectional diffusion model.

papers.title: Graph Neural Network Based Action Ranking for Planning
papers.tldr: A graph neural network learns local action rankings from small planning problems and transfers them to larger instances with improved success and plan quality.

papers.title: HCRMP: An LLM-Hinted Contextual Reinforcement Learning Framework for Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: HCRMP uses language-model hints to support an independently learning driving policy, reporting improved success and fewer collisions in CARLA.

papers.title: Improving planning and MBRL with temporally-extended actions
papers.tldr: Optimizing action duration alongside action choice enables faster, longer-reaching planning and improves model-based reinforcement learning in experiments.

papers.title: Learning and Planning Multi-Agent Tasks via an MoE-based World Model
papers.tldr: M3W uses a mixture-of-experts world model to share dynamics knowledge across related multi-agent tasks and plan actions through predicted rollouts.

papers.title: Learning from Reward-Free Offline Data: A Case for Planning with Latent Dynamics Models
papers.tldr: In reward-free offline navigation experiments, latent-dynamics planning uses data efficiently and generalizes well to unfamiliar layouts.

papers.title: Learning to Plan Like the Human Brain via Visuospatial Perception and Semantic-Episodic Synergistic Decision-Making
papers.tldr: NeuroMP combines brain-inspired graph construction and search guidance to improve motion-planning efficiency and path quality.

papers.title: One Subgoal at a Time: Zero-Shot Generalization to Arbitrary Linear Temporal Logic Requirements in Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: GenZ-LTL improves zero-shot generalization to temporal-logic tasks by decomposing them into reach-avoid problems solved one subgoal at a time.

papers.title: Planning with Quantized Opponent Models
papers.tldr: Quantized Opponent Models learn compact opponent types and maintain Bayesian beliefs over them to support efficient planning under uncertainty.

papers.title: Seeing through Uncertainty: Robust Task-Oriented Optimization in Visual Navigation
papers.tldr: NeuRO turns uncertain visual predictions into optimization constraints, improving multi-object navigation and generalization to unseen environments in reported experiments.

papers.title: State-Covering Trajectory Stitching for Diffusion Planners
papers.tldr: SCoTS creates diverse, extended trajectories without rewards, improving reported long-horizon planning and offline goal-conditioned learning.

papers.title: Tree-Guided Diffusion Planner
papers.tldr: TDP combines diverse trajectory exploration with targeted denoising in a tree search to improve planning using pretrained diffusion models.

papers.title: Tru-POMDP: Task Planning Under Uncertainty via Tree of Hypotheses and Open-Ended POMDPs
papers.tldr: Tru-POMDP combines hierarchical language-model hypotheses with Bayesian belief-space planning to improve robot task planning under uncertainty.

papers.title: What do you know? Bayesian knowledge inference for navigating agents
papers.tldr: A Bayesian navigation model infers what an agent knows about its environment from a trajectory while accounting for learning along the way.

papers.title: Wide-Horizon Thinking and Simulation-Based Evaluation for Real-World LLM Planning with Multifaceted Constraints
papers.tldr: MAoP organizes planning across multiple aspects, while Travel-Sim evaluates plans through simulation that captures dependencies between constraints.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Trajectory Planning for Signal Temporal Logic Tasks
papers.tldr: A hierarchical planner combines timed waypoints with pretrained diffusion trajectories to handle new temporal-logic tasks for systems with unknown dynamics.

papers.title: Action-Sufficient Goal Representations
papers.tldr: Goal representations learned through action prediction preserve distinctions that exact value prediction can miss, improving hierarchical control in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Active Curriculum Refinement for Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: PATH uses prerequisite graphs to broaden reinforcement-learning curricula and then focus training on regions the agent has not mastered.

papers.title: Adaptive Quasimetric Mapping : Principled Topological Abstraction for Robust Offline Goal-Conditioned Navigation
papers.tldr: AQM builds sparse navigation graphs from offline data and prunes unreliable routes during deployment, achieving competitive results with up to 100 times fewer keypoints.

papers.title: Bottleneck-Guided Spectral Subgoals For Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
papers.tldr: Spectral clustering identifies bottleneck states that guide offline goal-conditioned agents through useful intermediate goals.

papers.title: Chain-of-Goals Hierarchical Policy for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
papers.tldr: CoGHP improves long-horizon offline control by generating a chain of latent subgoals and an action within one sequential policy.

papers.title: Compositional Planning with Jumpy World Models
papers.tldr: Jumpy world models predict pretrained policies’ effects across timescales, improving zero-shot planning by composing those policies into longer behaviors.

papers.title: CorrectionPlanner: Self-Correction Planner with Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving
papers.tldr: CorrectionPlanner improves driving plans through a learned collision-checking loop that conditions revised actions on earlier unsafe proposals.

papers.title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models with OCL Search
papers.tldr: A modified Open-Closed List search combines learned rollouts and heuristics to improve generative planning efficiency and solution quality.

papers.title: FlowMAP: Flow Matching for Generalizable Agent Planning
papers.tldr: FlowMAP jointly trains a planning flow and action policy to move state distributions toward high-value outcomes under environmental shifts.

papers.title: Goal-Conditioned Agents that Learn Everything All at Once
papers.tldr: LEO learns about every goal in one network pass, achieving a 250-fold speedup over all-goals relabeling and strong results in the evaluated environments.

papers.title: Hierarchical Decision Making with Structured Policies: A Principled Design via Inverse Optimization
papers.tldr: The framework learns lower-level optimization structure from expert demonstrations to better align hierarchical decisions with long-term goals.

papers.title: HiMAP-Travel: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Planning for Long-Horizon Constrained Travel
papers.tldr: HiMAP-Travel coordinates parallel day-planning agents through shared constraints and replanning, improving itinerary pass rates and reducing latency.

papers.title: HiPER: Hierarchical Plan–Execute RL for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.tldr: HiPER improves multi-turn agent learning by jointly training persistent subgoal planning, action execution, and credit assignment across both timescales.

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Planners by Self-Supervised Action Gating with Energies
papers.tldr: SAGE improves diffusion planning by combining value estimates with learned transition-consistency scores when selecting candidate actions.

papers.title: Laplacian Representations for Decision-Time Planning
papers.tldr: ALPS uses Laplacian representations to organize planning across time scales and break distant goals into manageable subgoals.

papers.title: Latent Representation Alignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: LAVL combines latent-representation-based value learning with hierarchical planning, achieving top performance on 20 of 22 OGBench datasets.

papers.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Abstractions for Hierarchical Combinatorial Planning
papers.tldr: The framework improves hierarchical combinatorial planning by modeling variable action durations and learning context-dependent resource budgets.

papers.title: Learning to Search and Searching to Learn for Generalization in Planning
papers.tldr: A search-and-Q-learning loop learns relational planning heuristics that can generalize to much larger problems and sometimes solve them without search.

papers.title: MINT: Minimal Information Neuro-Symbolic Tree for Objective-Driven Knowledge-Gap Reasoning and Active Elicitation
papers.tldr: MINT combines symbolic interaction trees and neural planning to ask targeted human questions that improve plans with limited information.

papers.title: Parallel Stochastic Gradient-Based Planning for World Models
papers.tldr: Optimizing noisy virtual states enables parallel world-model planning with better success and convergence on evaluated long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: Position: Make Planning Research Rigorous Again!
papers.tldr: LLM planning research should adopt established automated-planning practices to avoid known pitfalls and improve evaluation rigor.

papers.title: RetrOrchestrator: A Multi-Step Retrosynthesis Agent Dynamically Orchestrating Single-Step Transition Models
papers.tldr: RetrOrchestrator improves retrosynthesis planning by jointly choosing the next molecule to expand and the single-step model best suited to that step.

papers.title: SAD-Flower: Flow Matching for Safe, Admissible, and Dynamically Consistent Planning
papers.tldr: SAD-Flower adds control-theoretic guidance to flow-matching planners to guarantee constraint satisfaction and dynamical consistency without retraining.

papers.title: Self-CriTeach: LLM Self-Teaching and Self-Critiquing for Improving Robotic Planning via Automated Domain Generation
papers.tldr: Self-CriTeach reuses LLM-generated planning domains as both reasoning supervision and structured rewards to improve robotic task planning.

papers.title: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
papers.tldr: Encouraging straighter latent trajectories improves world-model geometry, stabilizing gradient-based planning and increasing success on evaluated goal-reaching tasks.

papers.title: Test-Time Graph Search for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: TTGS adds training-free graph planning to existing goal-conditioned policies, substantially improving some difficult long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: TodoEvolve: Learning to Architect Agent Planning Systems
papers.tldr: TodoEvolve learns to generate and revise task-specific planning architectures, improving agent performance while keeping costs economical.

papers.title: Towards Feedback-to-Plan Decisions for Self-Evolving LLM Agents in CUDA Kernel Generation
papers.tldr: CUDAnalyst isolates feedback effects in CUDA-generation agents, finding that useful planning depends on aligned feedback and structured interactions among signals.

papers.title: Training-Free Guided Diffusion for Planning: A Unified Framework via Doob’s h-Transform with Safety Guarantees
papers.tldr: A Doob’s h-transform framework connects training-free diffusion planning guidance with approximation bounds and probabilistic constraint-satisfaction guarantees.
